meta.name: Machine breakdowns
meta.description: Jobs arrive every 4 min on average and take 2 min on one machine, both exponential. The machine fails on average 90 min after each repair, busy or idle, and is repaired in 10 min on average (exponential); a job in progress resumes after the repair. Availability MTTF/(MTTF + MTTR) = 0.9; utilization over available time 0.5/0.9 = 0.556. The run is 200 h long including 10 h of warm-up, so 190 h are measured.
